target: rab 'byor de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed cing / / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang yang nye bar gyur pa yin no/ / rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pas/
